definitions.explanation: The act of sending something again — a message, email, package, data, or document. Common in digital communication (resending an email or message) and in logistics (resending a package).

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{再送|さいそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{届|とど}かなかった→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{再送|さいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: It didn't arrive, so please resend it.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{送信|そうしん}→送信：17692_soushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{再送|さいそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Because the data transmission failed, a retransmission was performed automatically.

notes:
Combines ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again, re-) and {送|そう} (send). A straightforward and productive compound using the ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ prefix.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再送|さいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to resend
- {再送|さいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to request a resend
- {再送|さいそう}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: resending procedure
- ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧{再送|さいそう}: automatic retransmission
- {再送|さいそう}⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧: no need to resend

USAGE:
Very common in everyday digital communication — when an email bounces, a message fails to deliver, or a file needs to be sent again. Also used in logistics when a package is returned and needs to be reshipped. Can function as a noun or as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

RELATED {再〜|さい〜} COMPOUNDS:
- {再送信|さいそうしん}: retransmission (more technical/formal variant)
- {再発送|さいはっそう}: reshipment — specifically for packages and physical goods
- ⟦{再配達|さいはいたつ}→再配達：09690_saihaitatsu⟧: redelivery — when a delivery is reattempted
- {再入力|さいにゅうりょく}: re-entry (of data)
